channel.title: Royaltē Knowledge Hub
channel.description: Music royalty, publishing, and rights education from Royaltē.

item.title: The 35-Year Copyright Rule: Can Artists Really Get Their Rights Back?
item.description: Many artists believe they automatically regain music rights after 35 years. Learn what copyright termination actually means and how it really works.

item.title: What Is SoundExchange? (And Why Every Artist Should Understand Its Role)
item.description: SoundExchange administers specific digital performance royalties—often confused with a PRO. Learn what SoundExchange actually does for artists.

item.title: The Hidden Cost of Bad Metadata: How One Wrong ISRC Could Cost You Thousands in Royalties
item.description: One wrong ISRC can quietly cost artists thousands in royalties. Learn how metadata errors happen and why your recording's Digital Identity matters.

item.title: AI Music Is Exploding—But Who Actually Owns the Rights?
item.description: AI-generated music is exploding, but ownership remains unclear. Learn who actually owns AI-created music and how to protect your rights as an artist.

item.title: The Music Industry Runs on Data—Not Just Songs
item.description: Great music alone isn't enough anymore. Learn why the modern music industry runs on data—and how accurate information protects your royalties.

item.title: AI Didn't Kill Music—It Changed the Rules
item.description: Artificial intelligence isn't replacing musicians—it's changing the music business. Here's how artists can adapt while protecting their royalties, metadata, and rights.

item.title: Sync License vs Sample vs Beat License vs Cover Song vs Interpolation vs Parody: What's the Difference?
item.description: A practical breakdown of six music licensing types — sync licenses, samples, beat licenses, cover songs, interpolations, and parody — including which copyrights are involved and what permissions artists need.

item.title: The Backend Infrastructure Powering Modern Music
item.description: The systems behind every stream, sync, and royalty payment — and why independent artists need to understand them.

item.title: The Silent Money Leaks Killing Independent Artists
item.description: AI didn't break music's backend — it exposed how broken it already was. The metadata, publishing, and royalty leaks most artists never see.

item.title: Why Your Spotify Streams Don't Match Your Money
item.description: The reason Spotify stream counts and royalty payouts often don’t align — and the backend systems most artists never see.

item.title: Using Suno AI? Read This Before Releasing Anything.
item.description: The ownership, royalty, distribution, and copyright risks artists need to understand before commercially releasing AI-generated music.

item.title: Your Music Isn't The Problem. Your Backend Might Be Broken.
item.description: Streaming numbers look healthy but royalty payouts don't always match. This article breaks down how multiple royalty layers, fragmented backend systems, and incomplete metadata can quietly delay or misroute revenue — and what artists can do to spot it.
